checks.evidence: verify defaults: no FAIL. loop_seam PASS (wrap discontinuity 1.48x the 99th-percentile step, max 2; spectral change 2.2 dB, max 6), finite, peak -4.15 dBFS, dc -54 dB, rebuild bit-identical, macros PASS.

time_shape.evidence: Loop, 4.000 s. Dense bubble onsets: 211 fine onsets in 4 s = 53 events/s (per tenth 47-63/s, even); 64 onsets at 40 ms merge. Seeds 1-4: 203-215 fine onsets (51-54/s). Steadiness spread 5.8 LU, flat loudness curve in the picture, no trend.

spectrum.evidence: Energy shares: <200 Hz 1%, 200-2k 94%, 2k-8k 5%, >8k 0%, so 200 Hz-4 kHz holds about 99%. Centroid 1.28k/1.23k/1.18k Hz, rolloff about 1.6 kHz; bands peak at 1k (-24 dB) and 2k (-29 dB), 4k -41 dB, 8k+ -59 dB. Spectrogram: orange band at 0.8-2 kHz in each pop, stable across the loop.

parts.evidence: Individual bubble pops are separately visible: vertical bursts at 1-2 kHz in the spectrogram, with discrete peaks in the waveform and a 9.5 Hz amplitude-modulation line (9.7 dB). The brief names only the bubble onsets; the water bed under them is not separately visible (see notes).

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (weight, hiss, busyness); weight claim passes with a real move (centroid 1.9k -> 1.5k -> 1.2k -> 970 -> 771 Hz; sweep 1.97k / 1.28k / 798 Hz). hiss claim 'flatness rises' passes only on paper: flatness 0.001 at every step, and sweeps hiss 0/0.5/1 give centroid 1.28k/1.28k/1.30k and 2k-8k share 5/5/6%, almost inert. busyness is unclaimed (density 66/53/37 events/s for weight 0/.5/1, but busyness 0/.5/1 gives 56/53/50, with a 10.7 LU spread at 0). Seeds differ measurably (onsets 60-71, peak -3.0 to -4.9 dBFS, centroid start 1.17-1.28k) and all stay in the brief (200-2k 93-95%).

notes: hiss macro barely changes anything: flatness stays 0.001, so the claim passes on a vanishing change; the bed is inaudible by the measures
busyness is not monotonic in density (56 -> 53 -> 50 events/s over 0..1, and 10.7 LU loudness spread at 0), so the name over-claims; it is left unclaimed
weight at 1 drops fine onset density to 37/s and centroid to about 790 Hz, outside a boiling-water range; the default (0.5) is fine
